Trial Readiness: Ensure the attorney actively litigates in court rather than just processing quick insurance settlements.
Insurance Insider Knowledge: Lawyers who previously worked defending insurance companies often understand how adjusters try to minimize payouts.
Fee Structure: Reputable personal injury lawyers in Georgia operate on a contingency fee (typically taking 25% to 40% of the final recovery only if they win) and charge $0 for the initial consultation. Hammers Law Firm +1
Statute of Limitations: In Georgia, you generally have 2 years from the date of the crash to file a personal injury lawsuit, though claims against government entities require notice much sooner. Justia +1
